metadata.title: Trezor Suite model capability audit
metadata.evidence_method: Read implementation gates, composition, firmware compatibility config, manual scenarios and automated test/fixture sources; no application, emulator or hardware actions performed by this audit.

confidence_semantics.high: Explicit executable model/capability/version gate or composition evidence.
confidence_semantics.medium: Gate is explicit, but a product/model assignment is inferred from tests/fixtures instead of an exhaustive runtime allowlist.

scope_notes: Preserves every baseline feature; model variants normally enrich conditions rather than creating duplicate feature nodes.
Source minima are compatibility thresholds, not historical firmware releases or hardware launch claims. A missing config key is unspecified, never a claim of universal compatibility.
Test source and fixtures are intended states, never successful test-run evidence. Fixtures can omit capabilities and may predate current firmware.
Runtime model observations are linked only from the root-maintained manifest snapshot. They document reached states, not comprehensive model or firmware-boundary verification.
No seed words, PINs, passphrases, addresses, balances, device labels or account fixture values are copied.

Preserve them and use this matrix as additional model-condition evidence.
